articles.title: Frozen Squirrel Poop Tells a 700,000-Year-Old Story
articles.summary: Scientists thawed ancient squirrel poop from the Yukon and found DNA inside! It shows what ice-age squirrels ate—and reveals a surprise: they might be a different species than today's squirrels.

articles.title: Astronauts 'Save the Video Dish' in Spacewalk Repair
articles.summary: Two astronauts fixed a broken antenna on the International Space Station during a 6.5-hour spacewalk. Mission Control joked they 'saved the video dish'—just like the song 'Video Killed the Radio Star'!

articles.title: Too Much Screen Time at Age 1 Could Hurt Learning Later
articles.summary: A new study followed kids from age 1 to 10 and found that lots of screen time at age 1 and age 6 was linked to lower grades and weaker memory later. Timing matters, not just total time!
